body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> The Sharper Image presented its wireless speaker system equipped with a built-in iPod docking station during CES 2009. Adopting a LED display, it supports up to 5 hours of battery life.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
